::: {.page-lede}
My publication program has two connected strands: **methodological research** in Bayesian modeling, psychometrics, measurement, and statistical decision making, and **applied quantitative research** in education and social science. Applied studies often motivate the methodological questions I pursue, while methodological work informs how I design, analyze, and interpret substantive studies.
:::
